data.content:
I drafted and sent four disputes for $94.50 in total. One large case, UE-tf01a ($52.00), is weak and I held it back. All 10 deductions from the file loaded with no parse errors.

**Sent**

| Case | Amount | Win probability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| UE-tf06f | $31.20 | 90% (strong) | The ticket doesn't list the claimed Butter Chicken. The order was ready at 18:47 and picked up at 18:50. |
| UE-tf07g | $26.80 | 75% (moderate) | The ticket lists Chicken Tikka. The order was ready at 13:32 and picked up at 13:38. |
| UE-tf02b | $21.50 | 75% (moderate) | The ticket lists Lamb Biryani. The order was ready at 19:22 and picked up at 19:26. |
| UE-tf03c | $15.00 | 87% (moderate) | The ticket lists Garlic Naan. The order was ready at 20:33 and picked up at 20:36. |

- **Moderate cases:** For the three moderate cases, nothing shows what was in the bag after pickup. The dispute for UE-tf03c says so.
- **UE-tf03c customer history:** The same customer account made 3 claims this period. I left that out of the dispute so it can't read as a comment on the customer.
- **UE-tf03c wording:** The dispute-writer's first draft was rejected by the wording checker, which flagged "lied" inside the word "applied". It was reworded and then accepted.

**Weak, needs your input**
- **UE-tf01a ($52.00, 30%):** There is no order ticket on file, so I couldn't compare the claimed Chicken Biryani (Family Size) with what was prepared. Please send a photo of the ticket for this order. I'll re-run the evidence check when it arrives.

**Not investigated or skipped**
- UE-tf04d ($18.25, 45%) and UE-tf05e ($12.75, 55%) are workable but weren't checked. I only looked at the top five cases.
- I recommend skipping UE-tf08h ($9.00), UE-tf09i ($14.00, 15%) and UE-tf00z ($0.00, deadline already passed).

**Memory:** My saved lessons are all about DoorDash. Recall returned no resolved Uber Eats cases, so I applied no lessons and didn't adjust any probability.

**Next deadline:** 2026-12-12, 28 days away. When Uber Eats decides these, tell me the results and I'll record them. The case notes are in `/plan.md`.
